title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The document outlines the AI Office's decision-making process and the final resolution regarding AI policy implementation. It specifies key guidelines and responsibilities for ensuring AI is aligned with organizational goals.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: The policy announces an opening for Technology Specialists in AI, outlining the job’s purpose and the skills needed to support the organization’s AI initiatives. It also explains how applicants can apply and what responsibilities the specialists will hold within the AI team.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: This document announces a vacancy for the role of Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI Office. The position seeks an experienced professional to guide research strategy, oversee scientific projects, and advise senior leadership on AI policy and innovation.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: This policy outlines the available positions for legal officers within the AI office. It explains the qualifications, responsibilities, and application process for these roles.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: This policy explains how to fill vacant AI policy officer positions in the organization. It details the qualifications, application steps, and job responsibilities for those roles.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The document describes a scientific panel created under the AI Act to offer expert advice on the risks and benefits of AI technologies. It explains the panel’s membership, how it will assess AI systems, and how its recommendations will shape policies that promote safe, transparent, and responsible AI use.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: This draft requests the creation of standardized practices for AI development and deployment. It outlines proposed guidelines, objectives, and steps to ensure consistent, responsible AI use across the industry.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: This notice announces a consultation for the Community of Practice (CoP). It invites members to share their thoughts and feedback on proposed changes or developments within the CoP.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: The policy is a call for stakeholders to express interest in joining or forming a Community of Practice (CoP) focused on AI. It outlines eligibility, submission guidelines, and the benefits of participation, encouraging collaboration and shared learning among participants.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: This policy document presents a graphic overview of the iterative drafting process used by the community of practice. It outlines the steps of drafting, reviewing, revising, and finalizing policy documents in a collaborative, iterative manner.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: The policy includes a graphic that outlines the entire drafting process for the Community of Practice (CoP). It visually tracks each stage—from initial creation and stakeholder review through revisions and final approval—to provide a clear timeline of how the policy was developed.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document is the first draft of a Code of Practice that sets out guidelines and standards for responsible AI use. It aims to provide a framework for organizations to implement ethical, transparent, and compliant AI systems.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This document presents the second draft of a Code of Practice that sets out best practices and standards for the responsible development, deployment, and use of artificial intelligence. It provides guidance on issues such as transparency, accountability, fairness, safety, and the roles of stakeholders to ensure AI systems are aligned with societal values and legal requirements.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document outlines a third draft of a code of practice intended to guide responsible use and governance of AI technologies. It provides principles, standards, and recommendations for organizations to ensure ethical, transparent, and accountable AI deployment.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft outlines a collaborative framework for responsible AI development and deployment among stakeholders. It seeks to establish shared principles, governance mechanisms, and accountability measures to ensure AI technologies benefit society while mitigating risks.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a binding agreement that sets out shared principles and standards for the safe, ethical, and transparent use of artificial intelligence across sectors. It seeks to promote collaboration between governments, industry, and civil society to ensure AI development benefits society while mitigating risks.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: This document outlines the AI practices that are disallowed. It provides clear examples and explanations to help developers avoid violating these restrictions.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: The document explains how to identify and classify an AI system for regulatory and compliance purposes. It outlines key characteristics—such as the use of machine learning, automation of tasks, and influence on decision-making—to determine whether a technology counts as AI.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy outlines strategies to promote startups and innovation through clear, targeted communication. It highlights best practices for outreach, collaboration, and resource sharing to help a thriving entrepreneurial ecosystem.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups is an AI policy designed to support new companies in harnessing high-performance computing resources. It offers funding, training, and access to advanced HPC infrastructure to help start-ups innovate and scale their AI solutions.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar slideshows focus on risk management, explaining how to identify, assess, and mitigate potential risks. It covers key concepts and best practices for managing risk in various contexts.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This video is a webinar focused on risk management, explaining key concepts and best practices for identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks. It is aimed at professionals looking to improve their organization’s risk management strategies.
